planSteps.description: Navigate to / and wait for the login page to load
Open the 'Seleccione una empresa' dropdown and click the option 'Admagro'
Type 'HOC' into the Usuario field and 'wrong-password' into the Contraseña field, then click 'Ingresar'
Wait until the loading state finishes (up to 10 seconds)
The browser URL path remains / (login page) and an error alert is visible mentioning invalid credentials for client Admagro
The login form with fields 'Usuario' and 'Contraseña' is still visible
